summary: SciSparc Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing a November 3, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement with an institutional investor for up to $10,000,000 principal of convertible promissory notes. The initial closing issued a $3,000,000 note for $2,550,000 (85% of principal), plus a warrant for 11,457,269 ordinary shares at $0.5237, expiring November 2, 2029. Notes carry 4% interest (14% on default), convert at a variable price with a $0.11592 floor, and repay in ten monthly installments from May 2028. Proceeds fund working capital; structure resembles a routine variable-priced financing rather than a special situation, with dilution and floor-price risk the angles to watch.
